mapper.select: SELECT distinct c.USER_ID as userId ,d.NAME as userName FROM PAN_COMMON_FILE a LEFT JOIN PAN_FILE_PERMISSION b ON a.ID = b.COMMON_FILE_ID and b.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' LEFT JOIN PAN_USER_FILE c ON c.ID = a.USER_FILE_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_USER d ON b.USER_ID = d.ID WHERE b.USER_ID = #{userId} and a.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE'

SELECT a.ID as id, c.FILE_NAME as fileName, c.USER_ID as userId ,d.NAME as userName,a.USER_FILE_ID as userFileId, c.PARENT_ID as parentId, c.FILE_PATH as filePath,c.IS_DIR as isDir, c.FILE_ID as fileId, c.ROOT_DIR as rootDir, c.ORG_ID as orgId, c.`right` as right, c.DATA_SCOPE_ID as dataScopeId, c.LOCK_FLAG as lockFlag, c.FOLD_TYPE as foldType, c.EXTEND_NAME as extendName, c.FILE_SIZE as fileSize, c.DELETE_BATCH_NUM as deleteBatchNum, c.DELETE_TIME as deleteTime FROM PAN_COMMON_FILE a LEFT JOIN PAN_FILE_PERMISSION b ON a.ID = b.COMMON_FILE_ID and b.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' LEFT JOIN PAN_USER_FILE c ON c.ID = a.USER_FILE_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_USER d ON b.USER_ID = d.ID WHERE c.USER_ID = #{userId} and b.USER_ID = #{sessionUserId} and a.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE'

SELECT a.ID as id, c.FILE_NAME as fileName, b.USER_ID as userId ,d.NAME as userName,a.USER_FILE_ID as userFileId, c.PARENT_ID as parentId, c.FILE_PATH as filePath,c.IS_DIR as isDir, c.FILE_ID as fileId, c.ROOT_DIR as rootDir, c.ORG_ID as orgId, c.`right` as right, c.DATA_SCOPE_ID as dataScopeId, c.LOCK_FLAG as lockFlag, c.FOLD_TYPE as foldType, c.EXTEND_NAME as extendName, c.FILE_SIZE as fileSize, c.DELETE_BATCH_NUM as deleteBatchNum, c.DELETE_TIME as deleteTime FROM PAN_COMMON_FILE a LEFT JOIN PAN_FILE_PERMISSION b ON a.ID = b.COMMON_FILE_ID and b.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' LEFT JOIN PAN_USER_FILE c ON c.ID = a.USER_FILE_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_USER d ON b.USER_ID = d.ID WHERE c.USER_ID = #{userId} and c.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE'
